title: Spider-Man Was Buried Alive. Someone Took His Place.
description: Kraven’s Last Hunt (1987): the buried hero, the impostor and the hunter’s final test. This recaps the comic arc, not the Kraven movie. Dark themes; non-graphic illustrations.
hook: Spider-Man was buried alive. For two weeks, someone else wore his suit.
payoff: He even releases Vermin to test Peter, then stops the creature before it can kill him. Peter goes after Vermin.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: Spider-Man was buried alive. For two weeks, someone else wore his suit.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: In Kraven's Last Hunt, the hunter wants more than a kill. He wants to prove he can be a better Spider-Man.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: He shoots Peter and buries him, then puts on a copy of his black costume. But Peter isn't dead. He's trapped in a deathlike state.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Above ground, Kraven savagely attacks criminals. Newspapers say Spider-Man has gone berserk.
units.onscreen: THE CITY SEES THE WRONG SPIDER-MAN
units.visual_query: THE CITY SEES THE WRONG SPIDER-MAN

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Then he captures Vermin alone, a monster Peter once needed Captain America's help to defeat. To Kraven, that proves everything.
units.onscreen: HIS PROOF: A MONSTER CAPTURED ALONE
units.visual_query: HIS PROOF: A MONSTER CAPTURED ALONE

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: But two weeks later, Peter wakes underground. He claws through the earth and climbs out of his own grave.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: He reaches Kraven, expecting another fight. Kraven refuses. He believes he's already won by becoming the stronger hunter.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: He even releases Vermin to test Peter, then stops the creature before it can kill him. Peter goes after Vermin.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: Kraven leaves a confession and dies by suicide. Peter survives the hunt, but being buried alive leaves him traumatized. For more stories like this, subscribe.
units.onscreen: SURVIVAL DOES NOT ERASE THE HUNT
units.visual_query: SURVIVAL DOES NOT ERASE THE HUNT
